bio.name: Kevin Julio Pineda.
bio.body: Systems Engineer and Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience. I build web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, C#, and .NET: scalable frontend, REST APIs, and relational databases.

about.body: Systems Engineer and Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience building web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, C#, and .NET. Specialized in enterprise platforms and web products: scalable frontend, REST API integration, backend services, and relational databases with PostgreSQL and MySQL. I apply Clean Architecture and CQRS, and work with Docker, AWS, and agile methodologies alongside multidisciplinary teams.

items.description: Full-stack design and development of a SaaS for clinics: React, Next.js, and TypeScript on the frontend; C# and .NET on the backend. REST APIs, PostgreSQL with Entity Framework Core, authentication, roles, and per-module permissions in a multi-tenant architecture. Clean Architecture, CQRS, Repository, and Unit of Work. Patients, appointments, treatments, clinical records, payments, and real-time notifications. Docker containerization and backend deployment on AWS EC2 (Linux, services, and API exposure).

Contributed to a financial platform with authentication, digital signature, document management, and REST API integration. Led the frontend of a travel rewards redemption system, with autonomy to define the architecture and core features. Built enterprise applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Redux, applying Feature-Sliced Design. Collaborated with Backend, UX/UI, QA, and DevOps in agile environments using Docker.

Built the company's first e-commerce store from scratch and its first digital sales channel. Implemented predictive search, dynamic filters, a persistent cart, and interactive components. Improved technical SEO on Shopify so products and categories could be indexed and ranked on Google. Designed reusable, fully configurable sections so the team can manage content without changing code.

Built a headless store from scratch with React, TypeScript, Remix, and GraphQL, integrated with the Shopify Storefront API. Authentication, catalog with filters, persistent cart, wishlist, and checkout. Mobile-first UI with i18n (ES/EN) and multi-currency (COP/USD/EUR). Performance with SSR, lazy loading, intelligent caching, and Content Security Policy.

Delivered a full-stack solution for the restaurant: site, admin panel, database, and infrastructure. The panel manages dishes, promotional images, and content autonomously. Persistence with MySQL, images with Cloudflare Images, and deployment on a Linux VPS with Nginx.

formacion.title: Education
formacion.body: Systems Engineering at Universidad Simón Bolívar. During my studies I worked on programming fundamentals, data structures, networks, and relational databases. That foundation helps me understand how a complete application fits together, from the interface to persistence and deployment.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.body: Frontend is my specialty. I build applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, Redux for state management, and REST API integration. I apply Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) to scale by domain. I focus on enterprise platforms, e-commerce, and products with a maintainable frontend architecture.

fullstack.title: Full-stack
fullstack.body: I also cover the full cycle: REST APIs, business logic, PostgreSQL and MySQL, authentication, roles, and deployment. I work with C# and .NET, Entity Framework Core, Clean Architecture, CQRS, Repository, and Unit of Work. I containerize with Docker and deploy on Linux, Nginx, and AWS EC2 when the product needs it.

experiencia.title: Experience
experiencia.body: At Silver Holdings S.A.S. I contributed to a financial platform with authentication, digital signature, document management, and REST API integration. I led the frontend of a travel rewards redemption system: I defined the architecture with Feature-Sliced Design and implemented the core features with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Redux, in an agile team with Backend, UX/UI, QA, and DevOps. I also built Molaryx, a multi-tenant SaaS for clinics; Ferretería Rueda's first Shopify e-commerce store; a headless store with Remix and GraphQL for Verezza; and a full-stack solution with an admin panel, MySQL, and VPS for Chikos Gourmet.

actualidad.title: Current focus
actualidad.body: I keep deepening frontend and backend architecture. I build interfaces with React and Next.js, design REST APIs, work with relational databases, and ship applications to production with Docker and AWS. Available for remote, hybrid, or on-site roles, and open to relocating to any city in Colombia.
